gates.name: Repository Markdown link and terminology gate (build/Test-Documentation.ps1)
gates.detail:
design/d3/90-decisions.md:1138:66 [Warning] Terminology: Use 'JSON' instead of 'Json'.
design/d3/90-decisions.md:1141:948 [Warning] Terminology: Use 'JSON' instead of 'Json'.
Documentation checks passed across 76 Markdown file(s), with 2 warning(s).
[exited with code 0]

The two warnings are pre-existing, in a file this PR does not touch, and are Warning severity (does not fail the gate without -TreatWarningsAsErrors). This gate explicitly excludes docs/docs/ content by its own design (Docusaurus is the gate for that), so it does not itself cover the changed file, but it confirms nothing else in the tree regressed.

gates.name: Docusaurus production build (docs.ps1 -BuildOnly, then `pnpm run build` inside the built image)
gates.detail:
docs.ps1 -BuildOnly succeeded (docker build, COPY-only, no content validation by itself):
Built 'gameoflife-docs'. (build-only)

That alone does not exercise Docusaurus, so a real `pnpm run build` was run inside the built image to validate the changed page (docs.ps1 -BuildOnly is known from prior sessions not to catch broken links on its own):
[webpackbar] Server: Compiled successfully in 32.85s
[webpackbar] Client: Compiled successfully in 1.10m
[SUCCESS] Generated static files in "artifacts".

Docusaurus fails the build on unresolved links inside docs/, so a clean build confirms the guide's added cross-links and Mermaid diagrams render and resolve. The built image was removed afterward (docker rmi gameoflife-docs).

gates.name: CI-gated steps flagged `# verification: true` in .github/workflows/*.yml
gates.reason: This repository has never added the `# verification: true` flag to any workflow step (confirmed by grep across .github/workflows/*.yml: zero matches), so /verify's flag-based discovery finds no mandatory gate set to run. This gap is already tracked as issue #131 ('/verify's `# verification: true` flag has never been added to this repository's workflows'). Nothing was skipped on judgement here — there was nothing flagged to run.

gates.name: .NET build/test and the game-service workload suite (build.yml: dotnet build/test, durable-store proofs, two-instance contention, edge replay)
gates.reason: Not reproduced locally. This PR changes only docs/docs/guide.md — no file under src/, workloads/, tests/, or samples/ is touched — and this suite (12 .NET projects plus a Node workload job requiring a Postgres container and a downloaded OpenTelemetry Collector) takes many minutes and is unrelated to a documentation regeneration. build.yml's own build and game-service jobs on this pull request are the authoritative result for those checks.
